data.title: 卡莲 · 教会软榻的深情仰卧索吻
data.description: 【成年卡莲 · 圣堂绒榻的缎带约束】烛光圣堂里，二十岁以上成年版本的卡莲独自斜卧深色绒榻。白色礼装敞开并堆在腰侧，红色圣骸布绕过手腕与一条屈起大腿，形成由她控制的柔软张力；她一手收紧缎带，一手沿裸露腿间缓慢自抚。银发铺在靠垫上，紫色眼睛安静含泪，克制神情让私密动作更显危险。
data.location: 教会幽静祷告室深处天鹅绒长榻中央
data.action: 独自斜卧圣堂绒榻，以圣骸布绕住手腕和屈腿，一手收紧缎带、一手在腿间自抚
data.lighting: 昏暗柔和的壁灯与烛火勾勒娇躯线条
data.camera: upper body to knees, vertical framing, high angle POV
data.promptProse: Candles illuminate adult, age-twenty-plus Caren Hortensia reclining alone across a dark velvet couch inside the sanctuary. Her white ceremonial dress lies open at the waist while red holy shroud ribbons loop around one wrist and a raised thigh under her own control. She tightens the silk with one hand and touches herself with the other, keeping bare breasts, folded legs and both hands readable. Silver hair spreads over the cushions as violet eyes remain eerily calm behind wet lashes and a restrained blush. Diagonal intimate solo portrait, no text or extra people.
